Remark
[Mixed curvature of product metrics]

Source: petersen:page-0122 ↗ def:pet-ch3-sectional-curvature ↗ rem:pet-ch1-ex-1

1. ch3:3.4.9For Riemannian manifolds $(M,g_M),(N,g_N)$ with product metric $(M\times N,g_M+g_N)$, and $X$ a vector field on $M$, $Y$ on $N$ regarded on $M\times N$, show $\nabla _XY=0$; conclude that the mixed sectional curvature $\sec (X,Y)$ vanishes.
